name: Feint Partner [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
A little diversion is all your allies need to slip through your foe’s defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully feint an opponent, that opponent also loses their Dexterity bonus to AC against the next attack your ally makes against them before the end of your next turn.
